children: The Australian dollar weakens to a seven-month lows against its U.S. counterpart as a selloff in tech stocks weighs on risk-sensitive currencies. "The strong performance of the Democrats in the [U.S. midterm elections] has triggered investor concerns that the ongoing build out of AI data centers could be disrupted, and policy could shift towards implementing tighter regulation on the AI sector in the future," MUFG Bank's Lee Hardman says in a note. Adding to negative mood, Microsoft is tightening oversight of some data-center projects and stepping away from ones it deems risky due to delays, regulatory snags, and high costs, he says. The Australian dollar weakens 0.8% to US$0.6875 after earlier touching US$0.6860. (renae.dyer@wsj.com)
